resources.string: Restores the original branch and commit. Tracked edits and conflict resolutions made during this rebase will be discarded.
Drops the current commit from the replay. Review its changes before skipping; this can remove local work from the resulting history.
Local commits will be replayed onto the reviewed upstream and can receive new IDs. Rebase is local; push remains a separate action.
Rebase has conflicts — resolve them, then continue rebase
